clips.title: The story
paras: At Agamand Mills, Notched Ribs prove the Forsaken are breaking the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal.

Across northern Tirisfal Glades, the Scourge gathers skeletons in ruined armor. Cracked Skull Soldiers and Rattlecage Soldiers attack any living being or creature with free will they meet. Blades leave their brittle bones pitted and scored. Deathguards demand proof that Forsaken scouts and volunteers are killing these mindless intruders. A battle-marked rib shows that another of the Lich King's thralls has been shattered.

Northwest of Brill, the Agamand Mills hold a key position. If the Scourge settles among the ruined farmsteads and windmills, the undead gain a base from which to strike deep into Tirisfal. Deathguard Dillinger watches the northern roads and sends champions to break up the skeleton ranks before they can gather strength. The notched ribs brought back to Brill show that the Forsaken line holds as it wears down the Scourge vanguard bone by bone.
